code: library(HellingerDistanceEnrichment)  if (requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {   n_cells <- 120   meta <- data.frame(     subjectId = rep(paste0("Donor", 1:6), each = 20),     category = sample(paste0("Cluster", 0:3), n_cells, replace = TRUE),     group = rep(c("Control", "Control", "Control", "Case", "Case", "Case"), each = 20),     stringsAsFactors = FALSE   )    counts <- matrix(     stats::rpois(100 * n_cells, lambda = 2),     nrow = 100,     ncol = n_cells   )   colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", seq_len(n_cells))   rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", seq_len(100))    seu <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = meta)    composition <- ExtractClusterComposition(     seu,     subjectCol = "subjectId",     categoryCol = "category",     groupCol = "group"   )    print(composition)    result <- CompareGroupCompositions(     composition,     method = "permutation",     nPermutations = 50,     seed = 1   )   result$omnibus } else {   message("Seurat not installed; skipping Seurat example.") } #> Warning: Data is of class matrix. Bayes: Dirichlet posterior draw subject compositions, run full nested permutation null; report posterior mean p-value effect-size credible intervals. text: Compare subject-level categorical compositions (cluster counts, cell-type proportions) across experimental groups using Hellinger-distance enrichment ratios permutation conjugate Bayesian posterior-predictive inference. enrichment ratio, Jeffreys softening, label-permutation null, collapse/subset contrasts follow methods developed Paul Edlefsen. nested Dirichlet Bayes option implements planned extension propagates uncertainty estimated simplex compositions.

title: Hellinger distance enrichment for categorical composition data. — HellingerDistanceEnrichment
text: Edlefsen, P. Original Hellinger /within enrichment procedure subject-level categorical compositions (label permutation; Jeffreys-softened Hellinger distances), Bayesian composition uncertainty subsequent step.

what: Plot Hellinger enrichment contrasts with uncertainty. — PlotCompositionContrasts
title: Plot Hellinger enrichment contrasts with uncertainty. — PlotCompositionContrasts
text: Takes HellingerEnrichmentResult, maps pairwise contrast onto /within Hellinger ratio axis, returns ggplot. Bayes results drawn retained posterior effect-size draws (nPosterior rows per contrast) via ggdist::stat_halfeye, density slab needs samples rather summarized effectCiLow/effectCiHigh intervals. Permutation results draws, render points colored adjusted significance. showOmnibus TRUE, omnibus ratio overlaid dashed reference p-value labeled beside line.
